text: Google Search API scrapes Google search results through a documented HTTP endpoint (engine=google)
quote: Our Google Search API allows you to scrape results from the Google search page. The API endpoint is `https://serpapi.com/search?engine=google`

text: Searches can be set to originate from a specific location, with city-level precision recommended to simulate a real user
quote: Parameter defines from where you want the search to originate.

text: Requests are routed through the proxy server nearest the desired location for accurate localized results
quote: routes your request through the proxy server nearest to your desired location to ensure accuracy

text: Locations lookup returns matching canonical locations for a query such as Austin
quote: This prints the first 3 locations matching Austin (Texas, Texas, Rochester).

text: Results can be returned as structured JSON, raw HTML, or LLM-optimized markdown
quote: Parameter defines the format of the result. It can be set to `json` (default) to get a structured JSON of the results, `html` to get the raw HTML retrieved, or `md` to get a markdown-formatted version optimized for LLMs and AI agents.

text: Any search result can be served as clean markdown with the same data as JSON and roughly half the tokens, across every API
quote: Serve any SerpApi search result as clean markdown. Same data as JSON, zero configuration, roughly half the tokens. Works with every API.

text: Markdown output is available via output=md, a /search.md endpoint, or an Accept: text/markdown header
quote: Add `output=md` to any search request. Or use the `/search.md` endpoint directly. Or request `Accept: text/markdown` in your HTTP headers

text: Search data can be fed into RAG and AI pipelines to reduce hallucinations
quote: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Feed search data into AI pipelines to minimize hallucinations.

text: Google News API scrapes results from the Google News search page
quote: Our Google News API allows you to scrape results from the Google News search page.

text: Google News results can be filtered by topic token, such as World, Business, or Technology
quote: Parameter defines the Google News topic token. It is used for accessing the news results for a specific topic (e.g., "World", "Business", "Technology").

text: Google News searches can be localized with a two-letter country code
quote: Parameter defines the country to use for the Google News search. It's a two-letter country code.

text: ZeroTrace Mode stores no search parameters, files, or data after a search completes
quote: With ZeroTrace Mode enabled, we don't store your search parameters, files, or data. Once a search completes, it's as if it never happened.

text: Official Python client runs a search with query, location, and API key, and returns results as a dict
quote:
search = GoogleSearch({"q": "coffee", "location": "Austin,Texas", "api_key": "<your secret api key>"})
result = search.get_dict()

text: Official client libraries are available for multiple languages and authenticate with an API key
quote: Install the library for your language and use your API key to start searching

text: Legacy Python package is being deprecated in favor of the newer serpapi-python library
quote: This package will soon be **deprecated** in favor of [serpapi-python](https://github.com/serpapi/serpapi-python). We recommend migrating to the newer implementation to ensure continued support and access to the latest features and improveme

text: Python package scrapes and parses results from Google, Bing, Baidu, Yandex, Yahoo, Home Depot, eBay and more
quote: This Python package is meant to scrape and parse search results from Google, Bing, Baidu, Yandex, Yahoo, Home Depot, eBay and more, using SerpApi.

text: Script builder generates starter code to get going quickly
quote: SerpApi provides a script builder to get you started quickly.

text: Plans can be set to auto early-renew once all monthly searches are used
quote: You can set your plan to Automatic Early Renewal. It will trigger an early renewal once you've used all your searches.

text: Results are cached for 1 hour, and cached searches are free and don't count toward monthly quota
quote: Cache expires after 1h. Cached searches are free, and are not counted towards your searches per month.

text: Output can be limited to selected fields to reduce payload size and speed up responses
quote: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response.

text: U.S. Legal Shield covers the scraping and parsing of search engine data for lawful use
quote: Our U.S. Legal Shield covers the scraping and parsing of search engine data, as long as your use of the data or service is not illegal.

text: Legal Shield is included on the Production Plan and above, with up to $2 million in coverage
quote: Included with the Production Plan and above, with up to $2 million in coverage.

text: Searches can be submitted asynchronously and retrieved later instead of holding the connection open
quote: Parameter defines the way you want to submit your search to SerpApi. It can be set to `false` (default) to open an HTTP connection and keep it open until you got your search results, or `true` to just submit your search to SerpApi and retri

text: Searches Archive API retrieves results of previously submitted searches
quote: you'll need to use our Searches Archive API to retrieve your results

text: Queries support Google operators like site:, inurl:, and intitle:, plus advanced parameters such as as_dt and as_eq
quote: You can use anything that you would use in a regular Google search. e.g. `inurl:`, `site:`, `intitle:`. We also support advanced search query parameters such as as_dt and as_eq.

text: Public status page shows live API success rates and response times, with hourly metrics for the last 30 days
quote: Monitor SerpApi's live API success rates and response times.

text: MCP integration lets MCP-compatible agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor use SerpApi as a web search tool
quote: The MCP integration allows any MCP-compatible AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) to use SerpApi as a web search tool.

text: Tracks how content appears in Google AI Mode answers to monitor brand visibility for SEO
quote: Find out how your content is being used in AI-generated answers on Google AI Mode. Monitor your brand's visibility and optimize your SEO strategy for the future of search.

text: Scrapes sponsored Google results at a higher rate than the standard Google Search API
quote: Scrape sponsored results from Google search pages at a higher rate than the standard Google Search API.

text: Google Flights API scrapes Google Flights information
quote: Use SerpApi's Google Flights API to scrape Google Flights information.

text: Flights searches accept multiple comma-separated departure airports
quote: You can specify multiple departure airports by separating them with a comma. For example, `CDG,ORY,/m/04jpl`.

text: Google Flights Deals API returns destinations, prices, and dates
quote: Scrape Google Flights Deals with SerpApi's Google Flights Deals API. Destination, price, dates, and more available.

text: Free plan includes 250 searches per month at $0
quote: Free $ 0 / month 250 searches per month

text: Published plan table lists monthly price and search volume, such as Cloud 1M at $3,750/mo for 1,000,000 searches
Enterprise plans can be tailored to volume, performance, and compliance needs
quote: Start for free, upgrade as you grow, or contact our team about an enterprise plan tailored to your volume, performance, and compliance needs.

text: Google Ads Transparency Center API scrapes ad information, with optional filtering by target platform
quote: Use SerpApi's Google Ads Transparency Center API to scrape Ads information display on Google.

text: Interactive playground provides a live demo of each search engine API
quote: Head to the [playground](/playground?engine=google) for a live and interactive demo.

text: Each request runs immediately in a full browser, with CAPTCHAs solved automatically
quote: Each API request runs immediately – no waiting for results. In addition, each API request runs in a full browser, and we'll even solve all CAPTCHAs

text: Parses organic results plus Maps, Local, Stories, Shopping, Direct Answer, and Knowledge Graph
quote: Regular organic results are available as well as Maps, Local, Stories, Shopping, Direct Answer, and Knowledge Graph.

text: Google Autocomplete API scrapes suggestions for Chrome, Safari, Firefox, YouTube and other clients
quote: Scrape Google Autocomplete suggestion results with SerpApi's Google Autocomplete API. Chrome, Safari, Firefox, YouTube and more clients supported.

text: Google Events API extracts event titles, dates, links, and ticket info
quote: Use SerpApi's Google Events Engine Results API to scrape Google's Events Platform. Event titles, dates, links, ticket info and more.

text: Google Finance API extracts stock performance, prices, price movements, and related news
quote: Extract stock performance, values, price movements, related news, and more.

text: Google AI Mode API scrapes Google AI Mode results
quote: Use SerpApi's Google AI Mode API to scrape Google AI Mode Results.

text: Brave AI Mode API scrapes Brave AI search results, including text blocks and references
quote: Use SerpApi's Brave AI Mode API to scrape Brave AI search results including text blocks, references, and more.

text: Searches can emulate desktop, tablet, or mobile browsers
quote: It can be set to `desktop` (default) to use a regular browser, `tablet` to use a tablet browser (currently using iPads), or `mobile` to use a mobile browser.
